title: India's Ram Mandir Trust to Appoint CEO Through Merit-Based Selection Process
summary: The Ram Mandir Trust in India has announced plans to appoint a new CEO through a merit-based selection process, with a minimum of 20 years of experience required in administration or finance. The decision was made during the first meeting of a search committee tasked with selecting the CEO. The committee also decided that a graduate degree is the minimum qualification for the position.
summary_points: The Ram Mandir Trust has announced plans to appoint a new CEO through a merit-based selection process.
A minimum of 20 years of experience in administration or finance is required for the position.
A graduate degree is the minimum qualification for the CEO role.
The decision was made during the first meeting of a search committee tasked with selecting the CEO.
The committee's decisions aim to ensure transparency and fairness in the selection process.
title_hi: राम मंदिर ट्रस्ट ने सीईओ का चयन प्रक्रिया में विश्वसनीयता लाने का फैसला किया
summary_hi: राम मंदिर ट्रस्ट ने अपने नए सीईओ को चुनने के लिए एक विश्वसनीयता लाने वाली चयन प्रक्रिया की घोषणा की है, जिसमें प्रशासन या वित्त में कम से कम 20 वर्षों का अनुभव आवश्यक है। यह निर्णय सर्च कमिटी की पहली बैठक में लिया गया, जो सीईओ पद के लिए चयन करने के लिए बनाई गई थी।

framing.right: Right-leaning outlets focus on the significance of experience and qualifications for the CEO role, emphasizing the importance of a strong administrative or financial background. They also highlight the trust's commitment to appointing a CEO through a merit-based selection process.
